title: CliCommand
description: A command's own declaration: rsc/cli/<command>/<command>.json. EVERY command is a directory, whether or not it has verbs, so gaining a first verb is adding a file beside this one rather than converting a file into a directory first. Its DIRECTORY is the command word, so the name is not a field here — and a directory cannot hold two entries of one name, which is how uniqueness stops being a check. This schema lives beside what it describes rather than under rsc/schema/, which is the data domain: the CLI declaration is this repo's own interface, not corpus data.

summary.description: The one-line description shown against the command in `yoga -h`.

target.description: The repo-relative file the command execs, or prints when it is a .md. Its stem is the command word (#40) — held by naming.target_stem_matches_command, exactly for an executable and uppercased for a document.

calculus.description: Space-separated corpus-calculus terms and laws this command implements, each of which rsc/CALCULUS.md must define. Empty when it implements none.

step.description: Names the pipeline this command is a corpus-wide step of, when it is one. Absent otherwise.

args.description: Arguments accepted before any subcommand — the flags that attach to the bare noun, in the order they render.

sends.description: Outward calls this declaration makes — one line per call, naming it and its effect (#29). A send has no scratch form: redirecting where the result lands does not stop the call going out, so YOGA_NO_SEND=1 refuses it — reads degrade to UNVERIFIED, writes refuse loudly (src/main/send.py, src/main/send.sh).
